definitions.HELD: a stability floor, a coupling margin, a fold or pull-in margin, or a window edge built on one, read at the FORCE-PINNED operating point where |F_es| = 100 pN + P(g)A is fixed by a mechanical balance and k_es = -|F_es|/l identically, so a multiplier on the level is absorbed into the BIAS. WRONG ERROR BAR - restate or point
definitions.SHAPE: a ratio, a departure, a taper or a dishing fraction read on ONE field, in which the level enters as a COMMON FACTOR and divides out. ALSO the wrong error bar, for a DIFFERENT reason - CH-0170
definitions.LEVEL: a force, a pressure, a bias, a well depth or a decay length: the quantity IS a level, so C-0005's ratio is the right error bar and CH-0167 exempts it explicitly. LEFT ALONE
definitions.META: a sentence about C-0005, CH-0019, T-50 or CH-0167 itself, or a bare CITED provenance row. Not a transfer. LEFT ALONE

replacementQualifier.gradientThreshold: the decay length would have to be 9.73 % shorter, g* = -0.03766 nm^-1 - the shallowest of the 18 states that have a floor at all
replacementQualifier.whyTheseAreOfTHESAMEKIND: a margin is 33.3333 / max(0, -k_eff) with k_eff = |F_es|/l - k_brush, so a FORCE and a DECAY LENGTH are the two quantities it is built from; a ratio of a correction to a leading term is not
replacementQualifier.whatIsMeasuredAgainstThem: a factor of SIXTEEN swept in effective wall charge moves the margin by at most 1.44 %; finite ion size 1.4 % of the threshold; the bulk channel is EMPTY; C-0005's own broken expansion taken literally lands the margin at 1.0438 and not below one

findings: THE CENSUS REPRODUCES EXACTLY: 66 occurrences in 31 claims. F1 did not fire.

THE PARTITION IS 56 HELD, 7 SHAPE, 11 LEVEL, 26 META over the 101 in-scope occurrences - so 63 are addressed and 37 are LEFT, with the reason recorded per occurrence. CH-0167's own exemption (a free-tile quantity) is 11 of them and its own META class is 26.

F4 FIRED AND IT IS A THIRD CLASS: seven occurrences sit beside a RATIO, where the level enters as a COMMON FACTOR and cancels. C-0100 and C-0032 already write that argument in their own words, in the sentence next to the banner they do not apply it to. CH-0170.

A PERCENTAGE IS AN ERROR BAR ON THE THING ITS DENOMINATOR IS, and a quantity is exposed to it only if it is HOMOGENEOUS OF DEGREE ONE in that thing. A margin is not (it is pinned by a force balance); a ratio is not (it cancels); a force is. That is the one-line generalisation of CH-0167 and CH-0170 together.

NO VERDICT MOVES AND THREE GROUNDS DO - and one of the three is the strongest sentence in DECISIONS-FOR-NDI.md, 'the only margin in this repository that clears C-0005's own 123-214 %', which is WITHDRAWN rather than restated because no margin ever had to clear it.

validity: THE PARTITION IS A READING, not a derivation. It is retained as data (tools/T-220-classification.json) precisely so that it is falsifiable one occurrence at a time rather than as a whole.
THE GATE IS A PROXIMITY TEST, not a semantic one. It checks that a pointer FOLLOWS a HELD or SHAPE occurrence within 900 characters; it cannot check that the pointer says the right thing.

THE INDEX KEY IS FRAGILE UNDER CONCURRENT EDITING. The classification is keyed on (file, occurrence index within file), so a sibling inserting a new occurrence of the ratio ABOVE an existing one shifts every index below it. The tool reports that as 'unclassified' or 'stale' rather than mis-gating silently, which is the safe direction, and none of this task's own pointer text contains the ratio.

C-0137's THRESHOLDS ARE READ AT ONE STATE - C-0017's binding 10 nm / 2 mM / 7 nm held state, the shallowest of eighteen. They are quoted here as the replacement qualifier for margins at OTHER states too, which is exactly the discipline this task exists to enforce; the reason it is admissible is that the binding state is the shallowest, so every other state's threshold is further away.
NOTHING HERE NARROWS THE MEAN-FIELD EXPOSURE. C-0137 bounds it; this task only stops it being quoted against the wrong kind of quantity.
